test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Where can one read the complete history of a tree?

options.text: On its leaves in sunny days
On its branches when it is full-grown
On its skin when it is counted
On its trunk when it is cut down

solution:
The correct answer is **"On its trunk when it is cut down​."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

 
• The reason the correct answer is **"On its trunk when it is cut down"** is because the passage specifically mentions that *"When a tree is cut down and reveals its naked death-wound to the sun, one can read its whole history in the luminous, inscribed disk of its trunk."*
 
• This indicates that the complete history of the tree, including its struggles, growth, and experiences, can be observed on the trunk of the tree when it is cut down and its rings, scars, and other features are exposed.
 
• The correct answer is **Option 4**.
